tips.text: Join squads where everyone brings Radiant relics, and use a Resource Booster to afford the Void Traces.
Buy it with spare Ducats rather than prioritizing it over better items, unless you want the Mastery.
If it is missing, wait for another visit rather than overspending Ducats elsewhere.
Players call it Mastery fodder, an easy pick-up once you have a Ducat stockpile.
